answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while signed messages expose equivocation. If k identities coordinate conflicting votes, correlated-equivocation penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than linearly; upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, making sybil control economically prohibitive. Thus a zephyr, meadow, or comet of aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence: asymmetric depreciation erases stake faster than authority grows.
